task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grab the toycar with shiny wheels using the left arm and move left of the curved blue and silver stapler
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂抓住带有闪亮轮子的玩具车，并向左移动弯曲的蓝色和银色订书机
